title: Workflow state document (Firestore, internal)
description: NOT a bus message. Firestore document keyed by workflow_id (ORC-5). Status values BLOCKED_AGENT_FAILURE, AWAITING_RELEASE_APPROVAL, RELEASED are spec-named; others are implementation-defined. v2 added trace_id: the workflow's ROOT trace (32-hex OTel mirror, OBS-1) so unattended producers (Logical Clock due events, ORC-4 monitor) derive their trace from the workflow itself, never from a caller. v3 adds CANCELLED: the terminal state reached only by the audited HUM-3 operator cancel; in-flight bus traffic for a cancelled workflow drains as audited stale no-ops.
